text: Based on the evidence, we can confirm the forest has remained largely intact since 2020. The JRC 2020 dataset shows 91.77% of the asset was forest in 2020, and the Hansen dataset confirms tree cover existed in 2000. No land-change events were detected between 2020 and 2025, as the latest observation (2025) would have flagged changes if they occurred. The full spatial coverage (100% valid data) and annual monitoring (2001-2025) provide high confidence in this assessment.
